antiquark.wolf_targets_skeleton_horses.d: Wolves consider skeleton horses valid prey.
antiquark.villagers_seek_water.desc: Burning villagers try to reach nearby water.
antiquark.endermen_avoid_water_cauldrons: Endermen standing in water-filled cauldrons take damage and teleport.
antiquark.endermen_escape_boats.desc: Endermen riding boats or minecarts teleport away.
antiquark.hostile_mobs_cannot_ride.desc: Hostile mobs dismount from boats and minecarts.
antiquark.passive_mobs_cannot_ride.desc: Passive animals dismount from boats and minecarts.
antiquark.villagers_explode_in_the_nethe: Villagers attempting to sleep in the Nether or End explode.
antiquark.fearless_cats.desc: Some naturally spawned cats no longer flee from players.
antiquark.overlapping_nether_portals.des: Lighting a frame that overlaps an existing portal can create a second portal.
antiquark.contained_end_portals.desc: End portal blocks are generated strictly inside the 3x3 frame.
antiquark.nether_cauldrons_stay_dry.desc: Water cannot be placed into cauldrons in the Nether.
antiquark.powder_snow_cauldrons_hurt.des: Standing inside a powder snow cauldron causes freezing damage.
antiquark.falling_blocks_break_dripleave: Falling gravity blocks break big dripleaves and keep falling.
antiquark.falling_blocks_break_turtle_eg: Falling gravity blocks crush turtle eggs.
antiquark.leash_any_mob.desc: Leashes can attach to any mob in survival mode.
antiquark.void_totem.desc: Held totems of undying save you from the void and teleport you upward.
antiquark.guaranteed_zombie_villagers.de: Zombies always convert villagers below Hard difficulty.
antiquark.mine_from_boats.desc: Mining while in a boat is as fast as mining on foot.
antiquark.rainbow_wool.desc: Shearing a jeb_ sheep drops wool that cycles through every color.
